INTEGRATED SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

20. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
